pages.title: Belgian Draft
pages.text: Belgium's draft breed, and pound for pound the strongest horse here. Broader through the barrel than a Percheron and heavily feathered on all four legs, it pulls where the others carry.

pages.title: Coat
pages.text:
Almost every Belgian is sorrel with a flaxen mane and tail, a blaze and white legs. The bay and the roan come from the older Brabant stock, and black is a rarity.

- Flaxen Sorrel
- Dark Sorrel
- Mahogany Bay
- Mealy Sorrel
- Bay Roan *(uncommon)*
- Sabino *(uncommon)*
- Dapple Sorrel *(uncommon)*
- Smoky Black *(rare)*
- Black *(rare)*
